# Mistakes of Youth: The Blog

> > An archived anime and webcomic blog chronicling Japanese pop culture, animation analysis, and creative work from the late 2000s.

This blog documents personal experiences with anime production, webcomic creation, and life in Japan's otaku culture scene. The site features comic updates, convention reports, animation criticism, and commentary on series like Kirumin, Haruhi, and Durarara!!.

## Key Topics

- Anime criticism and analysis
- Webcomic production
- Japan life and culture
- Animation techniques (cel vs digital)
- Kirumin / Anyamaru Tantei Kiruminzuu
- Convention coverage (Otakon, NYAF, NYCC)
- Character art and illustration
- Akihabara and anime collecting
- Sakuga and visual analysis
- K-ON! and Kyoto Animation
- Durarara!!
- The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya
- Retro gaming and PlayStation
- Podcast interviews with industry figures
- Anime censorship and localization

## Anime Analysis & Criticism

- [The Greatest Battle In History: Cel Animation VS Digital Animation](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2009/11/03/the-greatest-battle-in-history-cel-animation-vs-digital-animation): Analysis comparing cel animation vs digital animation techniques
- [Kirumin was 50 episodes long (spoilers within)](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2010/10/02/kirumin-was-50-episodes-long-spoilers-within): Review of 50-episode kids anime Anyamaru Tantei Kiruminzuu with spoilers
- [A picture is worth a 1000 words… if you can come up with any](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2010/08/04/a-picture-is-worth-a-1000-words-if-you-can-come-up-with-any): Otakon 2010 panel on anime visual analysis and sakuga criticism

## Webcomic Updates & Creative Process

- [Comic Site Rant: BREAK+YOUR+DESTINY](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2009/02/07/comic-site-rant-breakyourdestiny): Behind-the-scenes webcomic production rant and Haruhi season two news
- [Comic Update: BREAKING YOUR FACE](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2009/05/11/comic-update-breaking-your-face): Comic update discussing K-ON!, KyoAni, and webcomic creation process
- [Comic Update: Whydunit?](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2010/02/13/comic-update-whydunit): Webcomic update discussing Durarara!! and drawing process
- [Comic Update: Dream Fighter](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2010/03/13/comic-update-dream-fighter): FUNimation Vampire Bund censorship controversy and Toonami nostalgia
- [Comic Update: I wanna stay with you](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2010/04/10/comic-update-i-wanna-stay-with-you): Webcomic update on manga, Japanese titles, and background drawing
- [Comic Update: Shiny Knight, Happy Child](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2010/10/19/comic-update-shiny-knight-happy-child): Comic update with NYAF/NYCC convention report and Pokemon Soul Silver

## Japan Life & Otaku Culture

- [Danny Choo's swanky blogger party: CGM Night 5](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2009/06/20/danny-choos-swanky-blogger-party-cgm-night-5): Report from Danny Choo's CGM Night 5 Tokyo blogger networking event
- [Yes, my sweet. Yes, my sweetest. I wanna get back Where you were.](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2009/08/06/yes-my-sweet-yes-my-sweetest-i-wanna-get-back-where-you-were): Akihabara shopping for Nadesico, Gundam, and anime collectibles
- [I could have bought the Japanese edition of Crash Bandicoot but…](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2009/07/31/i-could-have-bought-the-japanese-edition-of-crash-bandicoot-but): Retro gaming post about Intelligent Qube and PlayStation collecting

## Podcasts & Interviews

- [MoY Podcast 2 BEYOND THE TIME: Episode 18– The Matt Alt Interview Part I](https://blog.mistakesofyouth.com/2009/10/31/moy-podcast-2-beyond-the-time-episode-18%e2%80%93-the-matt-alt-interview-part-i): Podcast interview with Matt Alt on Japan, anime, and translation work
